selection: Only after final candidate binary, selector property rule and domain are frozen. Seeded draws are filtered by that CPU selector selecting the frozen candidate IDs; no performance-based filtering. Exclude the original1193 and every shape already used for design/discovery/qualification. Do not inspect or tune on heldout performance before final freeze.
failure_policy: Keep all failed heldouts and negative results. If design or property rule changes after a failed confirmation, freeze it again and use the next preregistered seed; do not reinterpret reused shapes as unseen.
precision: Whole output and real guards before timing, same frozen binary/epoch/config as confirmation
limitations: Finite tests establish evidence in tested attribute ranges, not every possible stride, pointer, or untested integer geometry.
